DrugRelation.title: DrugRelation

EntryOut.title: EntryOut
EntryOut.description: What the patient sees of an entry (their own answers; never triage or notes).

PatientAppointmentOut.title: PatientAppointmentOut
PatientAppointmentOut.description: The patient's view: when, where, with whom; the doctor's purpose and notes are not included.

PatientCreate.title: PatientCreate
PatientCreate.description:
Doctor creates a patient card. ``sex`` and ``timezone`` are needed from day one (local dates,
pregnancy applicability); every other safety fact starts as unknown (D-063).

PatientDocumentOut.title: PatientDocumentOut
PatientDocumentOut.description: The patient's view: no review note, no reviewer.

PatientEventOut.title: PatientEventOut
PatientEventOut.description: The patient's view: what they reported and whether the doctor has looked at it.

PatientReferralOut.title: PatientReferralOut
PatientReferralOut.description: What the patient sees: no internal reasoning.

PatientSubmissionOut.title: PatientSubmissionOut
PatientSubmissionOut.description: What the patient gets back after submitting: the answers were saved. Nothing else.

ReferralCategory.title: ReferralCategory
ReferralCategory.description: Spec §10: kept separate from the four urgency levels.

Role.title: Role
Role.description:
A person registers as PENDING (no clinical access); an admin makes them a DOCTOR, a doctor's
invite code makes them a PATIENT (D-088).

TriageLevel.title: TriageLevel
TriageLevel.description: Diary triage levels. Use ``rank`` (not the value) for ordering.

UpdateIn.title: UpdateIn
UpdateIn.description: Only the fields present are changed (``null`` clears place/link/purpose/note).
